label: Not rated yet
definition: Nobody has checked this club yet, or none of its sponsors are rated.

label: Clean
definition: Every sponsor and its owner checked. Nothing found.
plain: We checked every sponsor on the shirt and found nothing.

label: Spotted
definition: A lesser link, like a sponsor part-owned by a state with a record of abuses.
plain: A lesser link, like a sponsor that a state with a record of abuses partly owns, or a company found responsible for abuses.

label: Stained
definition: A serious sponsor on the front, or a severe one elsewhere.
plain: A sponsor with a serious record on the front, or a severe one elsewhere on the shirt.

label: Soaked
definition: A severe sponsor on the front, or two serious ones.
plain: A sponsor with a severe record on the front, or two serious ones.
